messages:
Alex (CSM): FYI — Mia from Zenith reached out about expanding to two new channels: in-store kiosks + POS receipt parsing. She quoted a timeline of next quarter. @Priya @Jordan can you weigh in on capacity/pricing?
Mia (Zenith): Hey team — yes, we want to run simple checkout suggestions on kiosks and parse receipts for returns analytics. Goal is to onboard 3 pilot stores first week then ramp.
Priya (AE): Sounds promising. Do we have any numbers yet on estimated traffic or QPS? Also curious if they need dedicated instances for compliance.
Mia (Zenith): Rough sketch: 10k requests/day initially, peaks up to ~30 rps during promos, avg latency target ~150ms. Data is PII-lite (transaction IDs + item names), retention limited.
Jordan (SE): 30 rps peak is notable. For model choice we should consider a quantized 13B or an embedding + rerank flow. Need to know burst concurrency and token length distribution. Any sample prompt sizes?
Mia (Zenith): Most prompts are short — 60-120 tokens. Some receipts can be longer, up to 400 tokens.
Sam (CSE): From infra side, this maps well to Dedicated with burst capacity. Suggest reserved pool of 1 GPU with autoscale burst to 2 for promos. Also recommend prefix caching for recurring kiosk prompts.
Priya (AE): I'll draft a preliminary commercial: reserved capacity + burst add-on + 90-day pilot discount. @billing-bot can you pull current Zenith usage baseline and billing cadence to attach to the quote? :eyes:
billing-bot: Pulling billing summary for account zenith_retail... found last 90 days usage: 12k tokens/day avg, no reserved commitments.
Jordan (SE): Technical ask list for customer kickoff: sample prompt set, peak concurrency windows, SLOs for latency, and whether receipts require private deployment/KMS. Sam — can you confirm KV cache behavior for 400-token receipts?
Sam (CSE): KV cache ok up to those lengths but caching efficiency drops on highly unique receipts. We should instrument cache hit metrics and estimate cost delta. I'll add a small test to our infra sandbox.
Emma (CS Lead): Alex/Priya — this is a clear expansion signal. Track as expansion_opportunity/zenith/2026 and flag renewal touchpoint. Coordinate enablement for analytics team onboarding.
Alex (CSM): Will schedule kickoff next Wed 10am PT. Agenda: traffic patterns, compliance, pilot success metrics, and pricing. Priya, Jordan, Sam — can you prep short slides (1-2 slides each)? :rocket:
Priya (AE): Yep, I'll have a draft quote and timeline ready.
Jordan (SE): I'll include model variant recommendations and expected latency/cost per 1k requests.
Sam (CSE): I'll add cache instrumentation plan and a quick runbook for scaling.
Mia (Zenith): Great — thanks all. Looking forward to the kickoff.
Alex (CSM): Cool. I'll update the account health dashboard and add enablement notes. Marking priority = high for pilot. :thumbsup:
